title: ATP Validation Result
description: Result of running a validator against a variable's verify_cmd output

status.description: pass=valid. warn=valid but anomalies detected. fail=invalid format or value. poison-suspected=validation passed structurally but poisoning heuristics triggered.

value_hash.description: SHA-256 of the verified value. Used to detect if a value has changed between sessions without storing the raw value.

previous_value_hash.description: Hash from the previous verification. If different, flag as changed.

poisoning_signals.description: Poisoning heuristic patterns that matched, if any
